The shared ancestry of L-dopa and L-phenylalanine, along with their binding to Slc7a8, supports a functional link between these entities. The presence of a lowest common ancestor in the non-proteinogenic amino acid category further suggests a conserved biological role in transport or metabolism. While the exact mechanism of interaction remains unclear, the evidence points to a potential functional relationship mediated by amino acid binding.
